summary: A DJR template page that reads like an illustrated magazine essay: the designer's first-person story of reviving Georg Trump's Schadow as Gimlet, punctuated by full-bleed figure bands in a mid-century orange/mustard/teal/navy palette (annotated anatomy, widths, italics, fun-fact glyph patterns), a Fonts In Use grid, then a very long on-page store where every package lists its styles as live pangram lines and the variable font gets its own axis sliders.

instances.look: Fixed thin navy DJR site bar above the hero (33px, never cut as a block, attached to 00): 'DAVID JONATHAN ROSS' left; FONTS ▾, CLUB, TYPESET, GLYPHS, NOTES, ABOUT, Sign in, Cart right, in small Input Sans caps

A short full-width banner of slanted stripes in orange, mustard and teal, with 'Gimlet!' in a tall white condensed italic filling the centre; the TRY · BUY · TYPESET · PDF button strip sits right under it
instances.ux: static; buttons in the strip below jump to the tester and store, open the Typeset tool or the PDF
instances.learn: A banner-height wordmark (not a full screen) plus a CTA strip gets visitors into the essay immediately; the exclamation mark gives the name its personality

reconstruction.layout: Full-bleed 1440×375px band starting under the 33px site bar; ~11 diagonal stripes (~130px wide, slanted ~10°) alternating orange/mustard/teal; wordmark ~760px wide centred, cap height ~260px
reconstruction.typography: 'Gimlet!' in Gimlet Display Condensed/Compressed Italic (Light–Regular), white, as an SVG image (gimlet-header.svg)
reconstruction.content: Family name with an exclamation mark
reconstruction.assets: Header SVG with stripes and wordmark

instances.look: Navy strip under the hero with four small orange buttons 'TRY', 'BUY', 'TYPESET', 'PDF' centred (anchors to #buy, typeset.djr.com/?ff=gimlet, the PDF specimen)

One six-line paragraph in dark serif on white, a navy link on 'Nick Sherman': 'Gimlet draws its inspiration from Georg Trump's 1938 typeface, Schadow… a typeface that is as funky as it is functional.'
instances.learn: Open with one larger paragraph in the text face: source, commissioner and promise in six lines

These figures aren't just tabular…they're fabular!', 'FUN FACT! Gimlet's widest character is the parts per mille sign…', 'GEE WHIZ! Gimlet's lowercase g is modeled after the open form found in Schadow…')
